text.p: OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE
CHARTER TOWNSHIP OF LINCOLN
COUNTY OF BERRIEN, STATE OF MICHIGAN
1997 UNLIMITED TAX GENERAL OBLIGATION
FIRE STATION BONDS

SEALED BIDS for the purchase of the above bonds will be received by the undersigned at the office of the Township Cl located at the Township Hall, 2055 West John Beers Road, Stevensville, Michigan 49127-1589, on Wednesday, the
28th day of May, 1997,

until 4:00 o'clock p.m., Eastern Daylight Time, at which tim place said bids will be publicly opened and read. Sealed bi for the purchase of the above bonds will also be received un the same time on the same date at the offices of Bendzinski Co., One Kennedy Square, Suite 2130, Detroit, Michigan 48226 which time and place said bids will be simultaneously opened read. The Township Board will meet at 5:00 o'clock p.m., on date to consider the award or rejection of bids.

OFFICIAL STATEMENT: A preliminary official statement that Township deems to be final as of its date, except for the omission of information permitted to be omitted by Rule 15c2 of the Securities and Exchange Commission, has been prepared may be obtained from Bendzinski & Co., financial consultant the Issuer, at the address and telephone listed under FINANC CONSULTANT below. The Township will furnish, upon request o successful bidder, copies of the final Official State relating to the above described issues within seven days fro date of sale specified above, in sufficient numbers to permi successful bidder to comply with Rule 15c2-12 of the Securit and Exchange Commission. The first 100 copies will be delive at the expense of the Township. Additional copies will be supplied upon the bidder's agreement to pay the reasonable copying charges of the Township for those copies. Any such

request for additional copies should be made to Bendzinski & within 24 hours of the date and time of the sale, and should forth the number of copies requested and the person and plac whom the final Official Statements should be delivered.
CONTINUING DISCLOSURE: The Township will agree in

resolution awarding the bonds to the winning bidder to provi cause to be provided, in accordance with the requirements of 15c2-12 promulgated by the Securities and Exchange Commissio or prior to the last day of the sixth month after the end of fiscal year of the Township commencing with the fiscal year March 31, 1997, (i) certain annual financial information and operating data, including audited financial statements for t preceding fiscal year, generally consistent with the informa contained or cross-referenced in the Official Statement rela to the bonds, (ii) timely notice of the occurrence of certai material events with respect to the bonds and (iii) timely n of a failure by the Township to provide the required annual financial information on or before the date specified in (i) above.
